To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have developed a multi-robot system with machine learning capabilities for cooperative transportation in an unknown environment.

we have developed a new multi-agent system architecture, which is able to learn the optimal strategy for a multi-agent system to transport an object in an unknown dynamic environments using a probabilistic switching method, where the optimal strategy is selected based on the state of the task and a set of learned strategies.

a physical multi- robot system is developed, which uses a new multi-agent decision making architecture, and integrates machine learning, robot force/motion and local modeling to carry out a cooperative transportation task in an unknown dynamic environments.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a novel multi-agent architecture, which integrates machine learning into a physical multi-transporter system.

the development of an intelligent system, which is capable of performing complex cooperative transportation tasks in unknown dynamic environments, and is based on the combination of multi-agent technology and machine-learning techniques.
the development of a new multi-robot architecture and the application of intelligent machine learning to the physical multi-robot systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
this paper provides a new architecture for a multi-robot system and integrates machine learning into the system for the first time.
a new architecture for multi-agent systems has been developed.
a multi-agent architecture is a powerful tool for developing multi-robot systems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the multi-robot system is able to learn the task in a dynamic environment with unknown obstacles, and to perform the task in a robust and adaptive manner.
the system has the capability of transporting a large object to a goal position and orientation, even in an unknown and dynamic environment.
the system has successfully demonstrated a multi-robot transportation task, which is a challenging task for multiple robots.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a physical system can be developed for the multi-robot task using a combination of multi-agent architecture and intelligent machine learning.
the multi-agent system with the integrated machine learning can provide the capability for the robots to adapt to the changing environment and achieve the task in the presence of uncertainties.

the multi-agent architecture and the machine learning techniques provide a flexible framework for solving the transportation problem, and the physical multi-robot platform provides a test-bed for the validation and verification of the proposed methods.
